## [Beyond Real Data: Synthetic Data through the Lens of Regularization](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/beyond-real-data)
*Apple ML Research* | 30/03/2026 | Score: 0.94

> Synthetic data can improve generalization when real data is scarce, but excessive reliance may introduce distributional mismatches that degrade performance. In this paper, we present a learning-theoretic framework to quantify the trade-off between synthetic and real data. Our approach leverages algorithmic stability to derive generalization error bounds, characterizing the optimal synthetic-to-real data ratio that minimizes expected test error as a function of the Wasserstein distance between the real and synthetic distributions.
